title: Courtline Enforcer
text: Courtline Enforcer plants a boundary spear in the road and treats every step beyond it as a violent appeal. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The border moves whenever the Court requires an offense.

defeatReward.text: Courtline Enforcer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
